cycles.summary: Finalized an unplanned-but-approved skill authored by a previous worker. SKILL.md, references (creditor-playbook, debtor-defense-guide), and the offline debt-balance.py script already existed and were verified working. This cycle added SKILL_HE.md, metadata.json, evidence.json, and this optimization log to bring the package to the standard Lawcal legal-tech skill format. Ran the script with example inputs (principal 12000, 2yr span, 5% interest, 2% linkage) -- exit 0, correct arithmetic. No claims fabricated; fees/floors/rates that change periodically are flagged as verify-current rather than asserted as fixed.

changes.detail: Added SKILL_HE.md: Hebrew mirror of the framework, procedure steps, gotchas, and reference links.
Added metadata.json (author, version 1.0.0, category, bilingual tags + display name/description, supported agents).
Added evidence.json documenting 7 claims sourced to the Execution Law 5727-1967, the Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Law 2018, and gov.il/kolzchut rights portals.

Verified scripts/debt-balance.py runs correctly with example inputs and produces the expected illustrative balance; --help documents the ponytail limitation (simple interest/flat linkage, not exact statutory compounding).

deferrals.reason: Opening fees, the protected-income floor, and interest/linkage rates change periodically. Per anti-fabrication, these are presented as verify-current prompts in SKILL.md/SKILL_HE.md rather than asserted as final numbers.
